facts.fact: RISA's 2024 guidelines bind all government institutions, central and local, to its rules for office networks: an institution building or upgrading a network must first seek RISA's guidance, buy network-room equipment under RISA's framework contract and size bandwidth to a table running from 15 Mbps for 1-10 users to 600 Mbps for 361-400; the document sets a standard and states no office as connected (dated to the copyright year, 2024).

systems.owner: each government institution, under RISA's guidance and framework contracts
systems.tiers: all government institutions, central and local, as a requirement
hosts government websites and critical systems of government institutions; no local government office named
